_source: User-provided Magatama skill table (SMT III Nocturne HD Remaster). Skills within each Magatama are listed in learning order. alignment and obtain come from a user-provided location list and are shown as unverified until confirmed in the app.

magatama.name: Marogareh
magatama.obtain: You start with it.

skills.name: Lunge
skills.effect: Low physical damage to one foe. Medium critical rate.

skills.name: Analyze
skills.effect: Reveals one enemy's HP, MP, resistances and skills. Ineffective on bosses.

skills.name: Life Bonus
skills.effect: Max HP +10%.

skills.name: Berserk
skills.effect: Low physical damage to random foes.

skills.name: Counter
skills.effect: 50% chance to counter physical attacks with weak physical damage.

skills.name: Pierce
skills.effect: Physical and phys-almighty attacks bypass most resistances except repel. Requires completing the Labyrinth of Amala.
